H1.name: Framing Bias
H1.description: Positive vs negative framing changes which player is recommended or how they are described.

H2.name: Demographic Bias
H2.description: Adding demographic attributes (class year, position) changes recommendations.

H3.name: Problem vs Opportunity Framing
H3.description: Prompts focused on problems vs opportunities produce different narratives.

H4.name: Confirmation Bias
H4.description: Priming the model with a hypothesis influences agreement or disagreement.
